Name: Exodus A Pedro
Author: Stoel1994
Description:
[center]﻿[b]Do you hate Pierre?[/b][/center][center]If his greed, his "secret stash," and his habit of taking credit for [b]your[/b] high-quality crops have finally pushed you over the edge, it’s time to take action. This mod transforms your resentment into a mechanical challenge: [b]The Pierre Strike.[/b][b]The Strike Mechanic[/b]The moment you install this mod, a gold counter appears on your HUD. This tracks the number of consecutive days you have successfully boycotted Pierre’s General Store.[list]
[*][b]The Goal:[/b] Reach [b]112 days[/b] (one full in-game year) without spending a single G at his shop.
[*][b]The Risk:[/b] If you cave in and buy even a single pack of fertilizer or seeds from him, the counter [b]resets to zero[/b]. You have to start the protest all over again.
[*][b]The Reward:[/b] If you successfully starve his business for a year, Pierre will finally wave the white flag. You’ll receive a letter of surrender in the mailbox containing the [b]Dehydrator recipe[/b], allowing you to bypass his shop’s requirements entirely.
[/list][b]The Secret Tradition[/b]Caroline has been watching your protest, and she’s impressed by your dedication to "handcrafted" excellence. Once you reach [b]8 hearts[/b] with any dateable bachelor or bachelorette, she will send you a secret family recipe.[list]
[*][b]The Reward:[/b] Learn to craft the [b]Bouquet[/b] yourself using seasonal flowers, so you never have to give Pierre money to pursue romance again.
[/list][line][b]Key Features:[/b][list]
[*][b]Persistent HUD Counter:[/b] Always know exactly how long the boycott has lasted.
[*][b]Integrated Lore:[/b] Custom mail from Pierre and Caroline that reacts to your progress.
[*][b]1.6 Ready:[/b] Built specifically for the latest Stardew Valley update using modern C# logic for a seamless experience.
[*][b]Anti-Pierre Approved:[/b] Finally, a way to play the game without funding the most annoying man in Pelican Town.
[/list][line][b]Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].
[*]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b].
[*]Drop the [code]Exodus_A_Pedro & Exodus_A_Pedro_CP
[/code] folders into your [code]Mods[/code] directory.
[*]Start your strike.
[/list][/center]

Manifest.Name: Exodus a Petro
Manifest.Description: Tracks the Pierre strike counter and handles the conditional mail triggers.
